evidence: Tests need EDIOutputFactory.FORMAT_ELEMENTS, reordered Validator(schema,null,true) ctor, and format() no longer throwing (assertHasError); whole test classes F2P so any compile mismatch fails all 40. FORMAT_ELEMENTS not in INTERFACE.

F2P are log lines like '=== () Starting server 127.0.0.1:24118 ok' and 'Average time to sort: 0.16 milliseconds'; port/timing-dependent IDs. Gold also adds unrelated lpFind assert fix with new corrupt-dump test.

Statement says suffixes start at '(1)'; test expects ['id_a','id_b','id_a(0)','id_b(0)','id_a(1)']. Second warning text 'only 1 unique values left' unspecified; numeric output must be str '4','5','6'.
Config key provider.apiGateway.websocketApiId given; tests check no 'WebsocketsApi' resource and authorizer ApiId == '5ezys3sght'. Natural fix. Coverage thin (routes/stage untested).

Tests use renamed field MinDistinctOperators and constant minDistinctOperators (package compile breaks all 79 F2P); statement only vaguely describes bug. INTERFACE gives field but not constant rename.

Statement's expected output keeps 'from andy.t_test for update' on one line; test expects FOR UPDATE as its own clause line and 'OF tbl.salary' indented. Repo convention (reserved commands) makes gold natural, but statement points elsewhere.
Both F2P IDs embed wall-clock time: 'Mon Feb 16 2026 20:49:36 GMT+0000' and 'foo::bar::baz::Mon Feb 16 2026 ...' (Date-valued test names); they cannot match on rerun and don't test the super() call.

Statement asks how to set totalResults; tests require params.totalResults name and exact TypeError "Expected 'totalResults' parameter to be a non-negative integer..." rejecting "1". Name/message follow existing itemsPerPage pattern, so inferable but not stated.

Statement: colors 'weird dark grey' (screenshots only). Tests require extract_color_from_hllist({'fg','sp'},...) table scope and extract_highlight_colors returning sp/undercurl; nothing points to guisp fallback.

Test patch self-contained (harness + weak_fn3 duplicated across two objects in a shared lib, expects 15). Error message points to exporting a non-canonical symbol; any real fix should pass. Repro needs external repo.

F2P are timestamp-parameterized unrelated tests, e.g. 'Test [6] filter=QueryFilter[field=START_DATE, ..., value=2026-02-16T18:01:29...]'; the new shouldUnqueueAQueuedFlowToCancelledState test isn't in F2P.

Only test_value_counts_sort_false relates to statement; F2P also includes test_wide_to_long_pyarrow_string_columns and test_np_matmul_1D[Index], fixed by unrelated gold changes (melt.py, Index.__array_ufunc__). Correct fix scores 1/3.
Task is Makefile/catalog build change; F2P are Go package lines like 'ok .../daemon/enricher 61.884s' and '(cached)', with timing in IDs and no relation to catalog format; a no-op could pass.
Statement is a UI feature (list frames in menu). Tests require CookieData.frameIdList field, 4th frameId arg to parseRequest/ResponseCookieHeader, and CookieStore.update merging frameIdList [1,2].

Statement is about from_native typing overloads for lazy frames; F2P only test_select_with_columns_empty_lazy: 'pytest.raises(ValueError, match="At least one"): df.with_columns()'. Typing fix irrelevant; raise-only patch passes.
Statement offers three options ('cxxbridge/rust.h', 'rust/cxxbridge.h', 'rust/cxx.h') with no decision; test header hardcodes '#include "rust/cxx.h"'.

Statement is a title plus migration-guide URL. Tests demand exact deps ('eslint-plugin-import-x', 'globals', 'typescript-eslint'), removal of '@vue/eslint-config-typescript', and lint script exactly "eslint .".
Test calls tt.Cache.InvalidateCache(), a name absent from the vague caching bug report; missing method breaks compile of hcops package, failing all 90 F2P (LB ops tests included).

Test file now does 'from aiohttp.connector import AddrInfoType' and uses TCPConnector(socket_factory=...) replacing tcp_sockopts; import failure sinks all 156 F2P. Gold also bundles unrelated DNS trace and content-type cache changes.

Gradient tests are fair, but F2P also needs tape.get_parameters(operations_only=True) and pytest.warns(match="Differentiating with respect to the input parameters of Hermitian"); neither stated. Correct fix gets ~2/4.
Tests assert exact message "- Field 'dayWeek' with value [XYZ] contains value(s) not included in [MON, TUE, ...]" and add month names (JAN...) never requested; only dayWeek acceptance is stated.

New jssue-7428 parser fixtures are not in F2P; F2P are 62 unrelated tests across crates (config::tests::object, fixer::tests::fixer_10, jsx fixtures...), suggesting flaky/build-dependent outcomes not tied to the arguments fix.

F2P is the whole trait package (26 tests, e.g. TestRoute_TLS). Test patch removes local FakeClient, calls NewCatalog(ctx, c) directly, and TestIntegrationAutoGeneratedDeps needs Integration.Sources() incl. GeneratedSources—unrelated to knative URL fix.

Statement and attribute test case are fine, but 18882 F2P IDs embed timings, e.g. 'Describe Command > Describe command with data set #0 [6.19 ms]'; they can't match on rerun and are unrelated to the fix.
All 9 F2P use deep.eq requiring a new 'auth: ''' field (even for Bitbucket/GitLab) and auth stripped from downloadUrl ('auth: 'username:password''); statement only asks for GitHub Enterprise hosts.

CNI patch-version tests are fair, but F2P includes TestValidateUpdateWindow/invalid_start_date expecting errors.New("cannot parse \"invalid\" as \"15\"") from an unrelated locksmith→time.Parse rewrite. Correct fix scores ~3/5.

Renaming transport()->Transport() is clear, but test adds digest case uri '/missing_value' expecting ErrDigestBadChallenge (gold adds unrelated 'len(r) != 2' digest fix); without it the parser can panic and sink the whole 179-test package.
Statement is a puzzle with no API; test requires package day344, type Tree map[int]map[int]struct{} (directed parent->children input) and func MaxRemovedEdgesEvenSubtrees(t Tree) int.

Statement is about comma-style with ignored array elements; F2P are CLI tests 'should not change exit code if no fatal errors are reported' for a new --exit-on-fatal-error flag. Comma-style fix is irrelevant to reward.

Both bugs stated, but tests compare exact wrapped output ('<https://...>`_ for more\n    details.') and the short-link input oddly lacks '>' ('<https://www.link.com`_'), so a fix keyed on '>' still crashes.
